PLAN THE WORK

A clear plan before the old suite comes out.

Start with what does not work in the current bathroom. Is the shower cramped? Is there too little storage? Would moving the toilet make better use of the space? A useful brief explains the problem, not just the style you like.

Connor coordinates the trades for your bathroom refurbishment, including plumbing, electrical work, tiling or wet walls, flooring and finishing. Agree the removal, preparation, fittings and handover requirements as part of your quote, with one point of contact for the project.

Choose supply and fit, or installation only with your own fittings. Share product choices before ordering so dimensions, connections and delivery dates can be checked. Existing conditions can affect the work once the old suite is removed; discuss how any changes to the agreed scope will be handled.

GOOD TO KNOW

Your questions,
answered.

How long will a renovation take?

The programme depends on the size of the room, alterations, product availability and the agreed trades. Ask for a schedule for your specific project.

Should I order a suite first?

Have the dimensions and plumbing requirements checked before you commit to products, especially when changing the layout.
